scientific_question: Do mechanism-direction-stable, ground-truth-free CDFM reliability signals predict graph risk on unseen mechanisms and unseen graph instances?

baselines.constant: mean training true_risk; expected risk-coverage equals family full risk
baselines.ood_only: robust metadata Mahalanobis score fitted on the 60 training tasks, then one-feature Ridge(alpha=1.0)
baselines.old_candidate_ridge: exact Gate-3A candidate feature construction, including DirectLiNGAM disagreement and training-fitted OOD score

gate.GO: both family Spearman rho > 0.30, mean rho > 0.40, both risk@50 < full risk, and mean relative risk reduction@50 >= 0.15
gate.BORDERLINE: GO fails, STOP does not apply, and either mean rho is in [0.25, 0.40] inclusive or exactly one family rho > 0.30, while both families have risk@50 < full risk
gate.STOP: mean rho < 0.25, or risk@50 is not lower than full risk in both families; evaluated after GO and before BORDERLINE
gate.confidence_caveat: If GO holds but primary is clearly worse than confidence-only, retain GO for existence of risk signal and state that incremental composite-diagnostic value remains BORDERLINE.

prohibitions: no feature, model, alpha, threshold, or normalization changes after confirmatory results
